snippet.title: BALDI'S BASICS: ENCOUNTER DOORS — OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
🎉 OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT – MAY 16, 2025 🎉
A new nightmare begins today.

Baldi's Basics: Encounter Doors combines the chaotic learning of Baldi with the unpredictable terror of DOORS in a brand-new horror experience.
New rooms to explore. New rules to learn. Nothing stays the same — every run is different.

🔐 Discover a room. Survive. But never expect the same path twice.
👁 Something is watching.
📚 Class... has just begun.

📅 Coming soon.
🔔 Subscribe and turn on notifications so you don’t miss what's next!
